name: Sideline Odds
description: Live odds and your bet on G2 while you watch the game. Say "20 on KC", tap YES. Hyperliquid testnet, Polymarket live odds, limits built in.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Talks to your own Sideline Odds server, which holds the Hyperliquid API wallet key.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Voice bets. Listens only after you tap (up to 5 s), and for 3 s after a card you asked for, to hear "yes" or "no". The audio goes to your Sideline Odds server, which sends it to OpenAI for transcription.
